Name: Amminadab
Summary: Amminadab was the father of Elisheba, Aaron's wife, and of Naashon, the prince of Judah.
KeyStory: Amminadab's children tied the priestly line to Judah's royal line: his daughter married Aaron, his son led Judah.
LifeLesson: God's story keeps moving through families we know almost nothing about — and He knows them all.
